title: Neural Score-Driven Volatility and Risk Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.05778v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a score-driven volatility model in which no particular parametric innovation distribution needs to be specified. The proposed method relies on a lightweight neural network to represent the negative score of the innovation density. By integrating and normalizing the learned score and imposing location-scale identification, we recover a flexible innovation density that can accommodate asymmetry, including negative skewness commonly observed in financial returns. Two estimation procedures are considered. A two-step procedure estimates the neural score by score matching and subsequently fits the volatility recursion with the identified density held fixed. A one-step procedure jointly refines the neural and volatility parameters under the conditional likelihood. We illustrate the practical relevance of the proposed method using eight international equity indices, with a separate evaluation of the high-volatility first half of 2020.

translated_title: 神经分数驱动的波动率与风险预测
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种分数驱动的波动率模型，该模型无需指定特定的参数化新息（扰动项）分布。所提出的方法依靠一个轻量级神经网络来表示新息密度的负分数。通过对学习到的分数进行积分和归一化，并施加位置-尺度可识别性约束，我们恢复出一个灵活的新息密度，该密度能够刻画不对称性，包括金融收益率中常见的负偏度。我们考虑了两种估计程序：两步法先通过分数匹配估计神经分数，随后在固定已识别密度的情况下拟合波动率递归；一步法则在条件似然框架下联合优化神经参数与波动率参数。我们利用八个国际股票指数展示了所提方法的实际应用价值，并对2020年上半年高波动时期进行了单独评估。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于轻量级神经网络表示分数的波动率模型，无需预设参数化新息分布即可灵活捕捉金融收益率的不对称性（如负偏度），从而提升波动率与风险预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a score-driven volatility model that uses a lightweight neural network to represent the score, eliminating the need for a parametric innovation distribution while flexibly capturing return asymmetry such as negative skewness, thereby improving volatility and risk forecasting.
